tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches official RocketVault product facts, solution pages, public documentation, editorial guides, and recent grounded coverage, returning public document IDs, titles, and canonical URLs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieves the complete official text and canonical citation URL for one public document ID.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Return current RocketVault prices, card limits, trial length, and eBay capability availability from the canonical pricing configuration.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
